name: SLURM cluster
description: A SLURM cluster sold in CPU and memory hours. The site agent creates accounts, syncs members and reports usage from SLURM. SLURM accounts in TRES-minutes, so each component's unit_factor converts its unit to those: 60000 CPU-minutes per thousand CPU-hours, 61440 MB-minutes per GB-hour. The cluster name is both the offering's backend ID and SLURM's cluster_name.

offering.name: HPC cluster
offering.description: Compute time on a SLURM cluster.

plans.name: Default
plans.description: Pay for the CPU and memory hours used.

parameters.label: Cluster name
parameters.description: SLURM's cluster_name. It is also the offering's backend ID, which usage reporting and diagnostics match accounts by. It must name a cluster SLURM already knows (sacctmgr list clusters): the agent refuses to start otherwise.

parameters.label: How usernames are generated
parameters.description: How project members get their SLURM usernames: anonymized (waldur_00001, always POSIX-safe), waldur_username (their portal username), full_name (john_doe_01), identity_claim (from the identity provider), freeipa, or service_provider (typed in by the provider for each user). The agent's base username backend does not generate usernames, so service_provider leaves members without accounts until the provider fills them in.

parameters.label: Default parent account
parameters.description: The SLURM account new customer accounts are created under.
